Meshy 汇聚了来自计算机图形学、人工智能与 3D 艺术领域的全球顶尖人才。团队成员毕业于 MIT、斯坦福、伯克利等世界一流高校，并曾任职于英伟达、微软等高科技企业。公司业务遍及全球，在多地设有分部，形成了多元包容的文化氛围与高效协同的全球协作机制。Meshy 的技术实力与创新潜力也赢得了资本市场的认可，已获得包括红杉资本、GGV 纪源资本在内的顶级机构 5200 万美元融资。

在行业影响力方面，Meshy 已确立全球领先地位。我们被 A16Z Games 2024 年度报告评选为最受欢迎的 3D AI 工具，并在 SimilarWeb 网站流量统计中位列第一，月访问量突破 300 万。目前，Meshy 已服务全球 500 万用户，累计生成 4000 万以上 3D 模型，成为越来越多创作者与开发者的信赖之选。

创始人兼 CEO 胡渊鸣（Ethan Yuanming Hu） 拥有 MIT 计算机图形学与人工智能博士学位。他主导开发了广受认可的 Taichi 编程语言，该项目在 GitHub 上收获超过 2.7 万星标，已被全球 300 多家机构采纳使用。

About Flexport:  
 At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 
 The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
 The opportunity: 
 Flexport is looking for a creative, technically-minded Senior Data Scientist who is excited about solving challenging problems in fulfillment and logistics. We provide ecommerce merchants a full range of "factory to door" logistics solutions. This role focuses on building automated decision-making processes that ensure that we meet or exceed the expectations of our merchants for fulfillment speed and reliability, while growing the network in a cost-efficient way.

In collaboration with multidisciplinary product, engineering, and business/operations teams, you will apply advanced Operations Research (OR) and Machine Learning (ML) methods to deliver data-driven insights and automated decision-making solutions in Flexport’s fulfillment products.
 Our business, product, and engineering teams collaborate closely with our Data Scientists to share domain knowledge, test hypotheses at scale, and develop promising solutions that can be quickly and widely deployed. We are passionate about providing effortlessly accessible intelligence and actionable insights to our end users. Our ideal candidate is: self-motivated, technically excellent at writing code, and passionate about delivering cutting-edge solutions.

 Design and develop models and algorithms to enable and improve the service of the fulfillment network, including optimal inventory management and reliable delivery service

 Contribute to data science and analytics best practices for the team and across the organization

 A degree in a quantitative field like Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Econometrics, etc.
